summary_1line: Nara and Narayana explain Narayana as the source of cosmic elements and the soul’s ascent into Vasudeva; Narada then devoutly worships and remains in their Himalayan retreat.

image_candidates.scene_text: The sages Nara and Narayana sit in austere meditation in their Himalayan retreat as Narada stands before them with folded hands.
A blazing solar gateway opens as liberated souls enter the sun and dissolve into radiant light on their path toward Narayana.
Narada performs worship with sacred mantras beside the snowy slopes of Himavat at the hermitage of Badari.
